name: Workers paid to third-party or multiple accounts
description: Wages are paid to accounts not held by the worker or split across several accounts.
fp: Workers may have family accounts or split pay by choice.

links.name: Payments to accounts held by third parties on behalf of workers
links.ctx: Earnings are routed to accounts of unrelated people or to multiple wallets, then consolidated.
links.fp: Agencies and family members sometimes receive payments.

links.name: Workers paid to multiple accounts or via third parties
links.ctx: Salaries are paid into accounts that control multiple 'employees' or into one account for numerous workers.
links.fp: Family or agency pooling can legitimately concentrate payments.
